_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 6 object handlers: stage-boss controller $06 and cannons $36/$37 ($A889-$AA9B). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: TYPE $06 (THE STAGE-BOSS CONTROLLER): first frame?
regions.description: TYPE $06 (THE STAGE-BOSS CONTROLLER): Type bit 7 set goes to the counting (`$A898`). Table stats: collision flags `$CA`, no hit points, art block 5, dies as type 0. It is the 'boss' of corridors 0, 7 and 17 (`$9151` = `$06`): invisible, it only decides when the stage's own parts are all gone.

regions.name: TYPES $36 / $37 (CANNONS MADE OF THE STAGE): first frame?
regions.description: TYPES $36 / $37 (CANNONS MADE OF THE STAGE): Type bit 7 set goes to `$A8FE`. Table stats: collision flags `$62` (`$36`) and `$72` (`$37`), hit points 4 / 8, attack 32 for both, drawing flags 0, art block 0, **dies as type `$30` (the blast of a broken block)**. These are ground objects spawned from the stage's own metatiles (`$89FB`): their position is the cell, and the fields 8 and 9 (`$05C0` / `$05D8`) hold the PPU address of the cell's top-left tile and field 11 (`$0608`) its attribute address low.
